sre-oncall: Heads-up: were seeing a brief spike of 5xx for small-generation requests in eu-west-3 starting ~11:24 UTC. Opening thread for timeline + mitigations. /cc @channel

ops-bot: [ALERT] edge-cache 5xx-rate > 2.5% (eu-west-3)

harry: Seeing repeated "manifest-not-found" errors from cache-proxy when clients request the rewrite model alias (rw-2026). Some edges fall back correctly, others return 503. Capturing logs.

devon: Quick mitigation applied: enabled fallback-routing to eu-west-1 for pinned tenants and toggled permissive-cache-mode to bypass strict alias checking.

harry: Log snippet:
```
2026-07-21T11:24:09Z ERROR cache-proxy: alias-resolve failed alias=rw-2026 err="not in manifest"
2026-07-21T11:24:10Z WARN edge: serve-fallback tenant=tenant-42 routed=eu-west-1
2026-07-21T11:25:31Z INFO cache: permissive-cache-mode=true
```

platform-eng: Initial hypothesis: a partial publish left stale alias entries on ~30% of artifact-store partitions. Some caches still had new alias names, others tried to fetch missing shards and got origin 404s. We're reconciling manifests now.

ops-bot: [ACTION] permissive-cache-mode toggled by devon at 11:25 UTC. Cross-region fallback enabled.

support: Customer impact: short-context hosted requests in eu-west-3 may have seen transient failures and higher tail latency. Drafting status blurb; will coordinate with platform-eng before publish.

platform-eng: Short-term status: error rate dropped from 2.8% -> 0.6% after permissive-mode and partial manifest reconciliation. Origin fetch throttles briefly observed; scaled artifact-store read pool by +40%.

harry: Commands used to reconcile manifests:
```
# reconcile missing alias partitions
python tools/manifest_reconcile.py --target eu-west-3 --aliases rw-2026
```

platform-eng: Next actions: 1) finish manifest reconciliation, 2) add publish barrier so manifests commit atomically across partitions, 3) add cache prewarm for alias publish windows. Postmortem owner: @harry.

status-bot: [STATUS PAGE] Draft preview: https://status.redwood.infra/incidents/2201003456-preview (publishing 11:40 UTC)

sre-oncall: ETA to normal: ~15-30 minutes while caches refill and reconciliation completes. Close thread when 5xx <0.5% for 15m.

support: I'll post the status update and notify CS for affected tenants.

ops-bot: [LINKS] Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/edge-cache.md | Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/edge-cache-eu-west-3?orgId=1

sre-oncall: Thanks all. Keep updates concise. If anything regresses escalate to PD immediately.
